{{Quote|Are you ready, Jedi? I'm tired of hunting these filthy Wookiees.|Ozzik Sturn, to Galen Marek|<ref name="TFU game" />}}
'''Ozzik Sturn''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Captain/Legends|captain]] and big game hunter. Using family connections, Sturn rose through the ranks of the [[Imperial Military/Legends|military]]. When assigned to various [[Planet/Legends|worlds]], he would spend time hunting native creatures, taking their heads as trophies. Sturn desperately wished for an opportunity to hunt a fugitive [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] during the [[Great Jedi Purge/Legends|Great Jedi Purge]]. He did not get his wish, however, as he was installed as [[Chief Magistrate (Galactic Empire)|Chief Magistrate]] on the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]] world [[Malastare/Legends|Malastare]].

No longer satisfied with hunting animals, Sturn had [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Prison/Legends|prisoners]] released into a private hunting reserve, in which he would hunt them down. This outraged Malastare's native [[Dug/Legends|Dugs]] and [[Gran/Legends|Grans]], so the captain was transferred to the [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of [[Kashyyyk/Legends|Kashyyyk]] and tasked with overseeing the construction of a large [[Skyhook (Kashyyyk)|skyhook]] in [[Orbit/Legends|orbit]] by Wookiee [[Slavery/Legends|slaves]]. There, he would hunt the native Wookiees, going so far as to wear their pelts as part of his uniform. He even had a private trophy room to display the severed heads of animals he had killed.

In [[2 BBY/Legends|2 BBY]], [[Princess/Legends|Princess]] [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]] of [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]] arrived on Kashyyyk as part of a trap set by [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] to prevent her father, [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Bail Prestor Organa/Legends|Bail Organa]], from [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|rebelling]] against the Empire. Should Senator Organa rebel, Sturn promised Leia that she would die in a Wookiee uprising. [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Rahm Kota/Legends|Rahm Kota]], an ally of Senator Organa's who had led a brief [[Battle of the TIE Fighter Construction Facility|rebellion against the Empire]] months earlier, learned of Leia's situation and tasked [[Galen Marek]]&mdash;"Starkiller," the secret apprentice of [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]]&mdash;with [[Mission to Kashyyyk (Great Jedi Purge)|rescuing]] her from Kashyyyk. Leia then, in turn, tasked Marek with destroying the [[Skyhook/Legends|skyhook]], and so Sturn finally saw his chance to hunt the man he assumed to be a Jedi. While Starkiller was busy removing the [[Tractor beam/Legends|tractor pins]] that anchored the skyhook to the planet's surface, Sturn entered his personal [[All Terrain Kashyyyk Transport|AT-KT]] and attempted to kill him. Starkiller destroyed his AT-KT and killed the captain instead, just before destroying the skyhook itself.

==Biography==
===Early career===
{{Quote|Captain Sturn? Be careful, Sturn's a madman. I'm surprised they gave him another command post after that nasty business on Malastare.''"<br />"''Give me the history lessons later, General.|Rahm Kota warns Starkiller about Sturn|<ref name="TFU game" />}}
[[File:OzzikSturn_greets_Leia.jpg|thumb|left|250px|Sturn "welcomes" Princess Leia to Kashyyyk.]]
Ozzik Sturn, a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]], was born into a privileged and wealthy family of [[Big game hunter/Legends|big game hunters]]. Using his family's connections, Sturn entered the [[Imperial Military/Legends|Imperial Military]] and rose through the ranks. Assigned to many [[Planet/Legends|worlds]] throughout his career, his deployments allowed him to carry on the family tradition of hunting [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy's]] most wild and exotic animals, often taking their heads as trophies. As his rank increased, however, Sturn's assignments left no room for hunting. During the [[Great Jedi Purge/Legends|Great Jedi Purge]] led by [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]], Sturn desperately longed for a chance to hunt a fugitive [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]].<ref name="TFU databank">''[[Star Wars: The Force Unleashed]]'' ''[[Star Wars: The Force Unleashed]]''</ref>

Sturn was instead transferred to various outposts in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]], and he became frustrated with his assignments. Eventually, he was installed as a [[Chief Magistrate (Galactic Empire)|Chief Magistrate]] on [[Malastare/Legends|Malastare]] in the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]]. There, he was again able to hunt, but he had grown tired with hunting [[Sentience/Legends|non-sentient]] animals. Instead, he had [[Politics/Legends|political]] [[Prison/Legends|prisoners]] released into a private hunting reserve, where he stalked and killed them. Though hidden, the hunting reserve was eventually discovered by the planet's native [[Dug/Legends|Dugs]] and [[Gran/Legends|Grans]]. Outraged, they revolted against [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] rule, and the Empire suffered a high casualty rate as a result.<ref name="TFU databank" /> Sturn was transferred to [[Kashyyyk/Legends|Kashyyyk]], the [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of the [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiees]], as a result; as of a [[1 BBY/Legends|year later]], the Empire had been unable to bring Malastare's population back under control.<ref name="TFUII">[[Star Wars: The Force Unleashed II (novelization)|''Star Wars: The Force Unleashed II'' novelization]]</ref>

===Supervisor on Kashyyyk===
{{Quote|Princess Leia. It's an honor to have a Senatorial observer.''"<br />"''You can drop the charade, Captain Sturn. We both know I was sent here as a hostage to keep my father from speaking out against the Empire.''"<br />"''Then we both understand the situation, Senator. If your father keeps his mouth shut, I'll keep you out of harm's way. If not, you'll become the unfortunate victim of a Wookiee uprising. These slaves are mindless brutes, you know.|Sturn greets Leia Organa on Kashyyyk|audio=SturnLeiaConvo-TFU.flac|<ref name="TFU game" />}}
[[File:OzzikSturnAT-KT.jpg|thumb|right|200px|Sturn, in his customized AT-KT, confronts Starkiller.]]
While on Kashyyyk, [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] Sturn supervised the construction of a [[Skyhook (Kashyyyk)|skyhook]] that, when completed, would ferry Wookiee [[Slavery/Legends|slaves]] across the galaxy<ref name="TFU game" /> to serve in the construction of Imperial projects, including the [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station/Legends|first Death Star]].<ref name="TFU novel">[[Star Wars: The Force Unleashed (novelization)|''Star Wars: The Force Unleashed'' novelization]]</ref> On Kashyyyk, Sturn hunted Wookiees, wearing their pelts and braids of hair on his uniform.<ref name="TFU databank" /> He maintained a trophy room as part of his personal quarters, and within the room he displayed the heads of a [[Reek/Legends|reek]], an [[Acklay/Legends|acklay]], a [[Nexu/Legends|nexu]], a [[Wampa/Legends|wampa]], a [[Tauntaun/Legends|tauntaun]], a [[Krayt dragon/Legends|krayt dragon]], and a [[Gorax/Legends|Gorax]], among many others. On one wall hung a [[Gungan/Legends|Gungan]] encased in [[Carbonite/Legends|carbonite]].<ref name="TFU game" />

In [[2 BBY/Legends|2 BBY]], opposition against the Empire was taking hold in the galaxy. [[Bail Prestor Organa/Legends|Bail Organa]], [[Senator/Legends|senator]] of [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]] in the [[Imperial Senate/Legends|Imperial Senate]] and [[Viceroy/Legends|viceroy]] of the [[House of Organa/Legends|House of Organa]], was one of several senators who felt that a change was needed. Organa, along with Senator [[Mon Mothma/Legends|Mon Mothma]] of [[Chandrila/Legends|Chandrila]] and Senator [[Garm Bel Iblis/Legends|Garm Bel Iblis]] of [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]], had been planning to create an organized rebellion against the Empire, but they were unwilling to take direct action. The [[Palpatine/Legends|Emperor]] knew of the growing dissent in the Imperial Senate, so he had [[Princess/Legends|Princess]] [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]], Bail's adopted daughter, sent to Kashyyyk as a "senatorial observer"&mdash;in reality, she was there as a hostage, so that her father would think twice about rebelling.<ref name="TFU game" />

The princess arrived on Kashyyyk in a [[Lambda-class T-4a shuttle/Legends|''Lambda''-class shuttle]], escorted by the Emperor's [[Emperor's Royal Guard/Legends|Royal Guards]]. Sturn greeted her when she landed, but Organa knew the truth behind her visit. Sturn responded that, as long as her father remained loyal to the Empire, no harm would come to her. If, however, she did not, Sturn would have her executed and blame her [[Death/Legends|death]] on a Wookiee uprising. Sturn had Organa and her [[Astromech droid/Legends|astromech droid]] [[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2]] sealed in his quarters.<ref name="TFU game" />

News of his daughter's imprisonment reached Bail Organa, who then asked his ally [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Rahm Kota/Legends|Rahm Kota]], who had previously led his [[Kota's Militia|militia]] in the [[Battle of the TIE Fighter Construction Facility|capture]] of a [[TIE Fighter Construction Facility]] above [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]] months earlier, to rescue her. Kota assigned the task to [[Galen Marek|Starkiller]], [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader's]] secret apprentice who had defeated Kota and his militia aboard the construction facility. Starkiller had secretly been tasked by his [[Sith Master/Legends|master]] with uniting the rebellious elements so the Empire could crush them once and for all, and he had been instructed to do whatever was necessary to complete the task. This included seeking out Kota, earning the trust of the would-be rebel leaders, and killing any Imperials.<ref name="TFU game" />

Starkiller [[Mission to Kashyyyk (Great Jedi Purge)|landed on Kashyyyk]] and discovered Organa in Sturn's quarters, but she refused to leave until the [[Skyhook/Legends|skyhook]] was destroyed and the Wookiees could be liberated. Starkiller fought his way to the skyhook's mooring structure and began removing the [[Tractor beam/Legends|tractor pins]] that kept the skyhook anchored to the ground, cutting through any [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]], [[Scout trooper/Legends|scout troopers]], [[Jumptrooper/Legends|jumptroopers]], or [[purge trooper]]s that stood in his way. Before all the pins could be removed, Sturn entered the scene in his personal [[All Terrain Kashyyyk Transport|AT-KT]] and engaged the man he assumed to be a Jedi, fulfilling his desire to hunt one. Using his [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] and [[The Force/Legends|the Force]], Starkiller destroyed the AT-KT and killed Sturn, before destroying the skyhook itself.<ref name="TFU game" />

With Sturn and the majority of the Imperial forces in the area dead, the Wookiees began celebrating. Princess Organa was able to return to her father unharmed, and, after a series of confrontations with the Empire, Starkiller convinced senators Organa, Mothma, and Bel Iblis to sign the [[Corellian Treaty]], officially forming the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]].<ref name="TFU game" />

==Personality and traits==
{{Quote|Well, now, this is a surprise&hellip; A Jedi. I always hoped I'd be able to hunt one of your kind.|Sturn, to Starkiller|<ref name="TFU game" />}}
Ozzik Sturn was an overconfident commander, believing that he could easily defeat a Jedi with whatever means were at his disposal. Rahm Kota had even described him as a madman. This proved to be the Captain's downfall, as Starkiller was able to destroy his AT-KT and kill him.<ref name="TFU game" /> As he had been born into a family of big game hunters, Sturn had also taken up hunting. But hunting non-sentient creatures was not enough; he made the move from hunting animals to hunting [[Sentience/Legends|sentients]] while stationed as Chief [[Magistrate/Legends|Magistrate]] on Malastare. This sudden desire to hunt prisoners led to a revolt against the Empire, but Sturn remained an [[Imperial officer/Legends|Imperial officer]]. Transferred to Kashyyyk, he started to hunt the native Wookiees, despite being assigned there to oversee their enslavement.<ref name="TFU databank" /> He proudly wore a Wookiee pelt draped across his uniform and brands of Wookiee hair on his left shoulder.<ref name="TFU game" /><ref name="Art" />

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:SturnWarning.png|thumb|right|250px|Concept art of Ozzik Sturn]]
{{Quote|We wanted a boss that was an Imperial Officer. At one point we thought he'd be a weird monster or shape-shifter so I did these [in the vein of] Phantom of the Opera and Predator [above]. We ended up making Ozzik a crazed hunter.|[[Amy Beth Christenson]]|<ref name="Art">''[[The Art and Making of Star Wars: The Force Unleashed]]''</ref>}}
Ozzik Sturn was created for [[Star Wars: The Force Unleashed|''The Force Unleashed'']] [[Star Wars video games|video game]], needng an [[Imperial officer/Legends|Imperial officer]] as a final level boss, reminiscent of the cold and determined Imperial characters of the [[original trilogy]]. From the first conceptions Sturn was envisioned as cold-hearted and merciless [[speciesism|speciesist]]. Earliest ideas explored the possibility of him being more supernatural, such as [[Changeling/Legends|shape-shifting]]. Later concepts wanted him a ruthless killer; while in his final appearance he wears only a Wookiee pelt embellishing his formal uniform, earlier concept art had it embellished with trophies, animal skins or leather boots.<ref name="Art" />

Sturn first appeared in the [[2008]] [[Star Wars: The Force Unleashed (novelization)|novelization]] of ''The Force Unleashed''. In the game, he was voiced by [[Tom Kane]], who also provided his likeness for the captain.<ref name="TFU game" /> Sturn was given a brief entry in ''[[The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia]]''. 

In the [[Wikipedia:Xbox 360|Xbox 360]] and [[Wikipedia:PlayStation 3|PlayStation 3]] version of ''The Force Unleashed'' video game, Sturn is depicted as wearing a white uniform that strongly resembles that of the Imperial [[Grand Admiral/Legends|Grand Admirals]]<ref name="Who's Who">{{InsiderCite|66|Who's Who: Imperial Grand Admirals}}</ref> or even the uniform of an [[Imperial Security Bureau/Legends|Imperial Security Bureau]] officer like [[Wullf Yularen/Legends|Wullf Yularen]],<ref name="ANH">{{Film|IV}}</ref> despite the fact that he is stated to be a captain.<ref name="TFU novel" /> Additionally, his rank badge would seem to denote him as a [[Colonel/Legends|colonel]], [[Major/Legends|major]], or even [[General/Legends|general]], according to the tabulation presented in the ''[[Imperial Sourcebook]]''.

In the [[Wikipedia:PlayStation 2|PlayStation 2]], [[Wikipedia:PlayStation Portable|PlayStation Portable]], and [[Wikipedia:Wii|Wii]] version of ''The Force Unleashed'', Sturn wears the uniform of an [[Vehicle Command Crewer|AT-ST pilot]] with his Wookiee pelt. In this version of the game, Sturn emerges from his destroyed AT-KT, only to be [[Shiak|impaled]] by Starkiller with his lightsaber. In the [[Wikipedia:Nintendo DS|Nintendo DS]] version of the game, Sturn pilots an [[All Terrain Recon Transport/Legends|AT-RT]] instead of an AT-KT. In the cell phone version, the Imperial commander on Kashyyyk wears a standard uniform and is equipped with a [[Lightwhip/Legends|lightwhip]], although he is never identified as Sturn.

In the [[Wikipedia:N-Gage (service)|N-Gage]] and the [[Wikipedia:iPhone|iPhone]]/[[Wikipedia:iPod Touch|iPod Touch]] versions of the game, Starkiller rescues Organa from a group of escorting stormtroopers in the forest. Not willing to leave while the planet's population is enslaved, Organa sends Starkiller to liberate Wookiees from a nearby prison compound. After he has set the slaves free, Starkiller faces off against an [[Electrostaff/Legends|electrostaff]]-wielding Sturn inside the prison. The captain is also assisted by two AT-STs. Starkiller, however, manages to push the AT-STs out of the prison building and closes the doors through which they have come. When Sturn charges him with the electrostaff, Starkiller kills him with a discharge of [[Force lightning/Legends|Force lightning]].
[[File:HothStyleSturn.png|thumb|right|200px|Sturn, as depicted in the PS2/PSP/Wii version of ''The Force Unleashed'']]
